import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sqlalchemy import text

# Retrieve only coordinates needed for NEW_TOWN air-quality stations
stations = pd.read_sql(text("""
SELECT ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS longitude, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS latitude
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE area_type = 'NEW_TOWN'
"""), engine)
